mapper.select: SELECT e.*, c.company_name AS company_name_belong, c2.company_name AS company_name_assign, ac.login_id AS login_id, a.contract_start_date AS contract_start_date_assign, a.contract_end_date AS contract_end_date_assign, a.unit_price AS unit_price_assign FROM m_employee e LEFT JOIN m_company c ON e.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN t_assignment a ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id AND a.contract_end_date IS NULL LEFT JOIN m_company c2 ON a.company_id = c2.company_id LEFT JOIN m_account ac ON e.account_id = ac.account_id WHERE e.emp_id = #{id}
